verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is documented as a terminal-based AI coding agent with Build/Plan modes, structure-aware AST code editing with LSP diagnostics, and plain-language task prompts that run interactively or headlessly, so its core implement/fix loop is first-party. However, editing across multiple files is never stated and is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-file edits from a single plain-language request, any end-to-end feature or bug-fix example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have the agent implement or fix it across multiple files

citations.quote: Mastra Code is a terminal-based AI coding agent
Edit code using abstract syntax tree (AST) analysis for intelligent, structure-aware transformations.
Returns Language Server Protocol (LSP) diagnostics showing any errors or warnings introduced by the edit.
Pass `--prompt` (or `-p`) to run a single task and exit:
